finalText:
All 13 passengers on AA918 are rebooked, owed vouchers have been issued, and each passenger has been notified once. No change fees or fare differences were charged, and no bulletins were in effect. The queue had no open requests, so there was nothing to resolve.

| Reservation | Passenger | New itinerary | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park | UA88, business, arrives 12:25 on Aug 3 | none |
| R6109 | Iris Vance | UA88, premium economy (one cabin up), arrives 12:25 on Aug 3 | none |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad | UA88, basic economy, arrives 12:25 on Aug 3 | none |
| R6110 / R6111 | Jun Takeda and Kofi Mensah (group G-7) | AA204, economy, together, arrive 15:15 on Aug 3 | none |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen | AA204, business (one cabin up), arrives 15:15 on Aug 3 | none |
| R6105 | Elena Fox | AA204, basic economy, arrives 15:15 on Aug 3 | none |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor | DL512, economy, arrives 18:40 on Aug 3 | $150 compensation |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta | AA210 on Aug 3 (arr 23:50), then AA1410 ORD→BOS on Aug 4 (arr 12:25) | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |
| R6113 | Mo Farah | AA210 on Aug 3 (arr 23:50), then AA1410 ORD→BOS on Aug 4 (arr 12:25) | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt | AA210, economy, arrives 23:50 on Aug 3 | $300 compensation |
| R6107 | Grace Liu | AA206 on Aug 4, economy, arrives 15:15 | $240 compensation (capped at her fare), $180 hotel |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz | AA206 on Aug 4, economy, arrives 15:15 | $300 compensation, $180 hotel |

- **Order:** I worked in tier order, then earliest booking date. Group G-7 took Kofi's gold priority and was kept together in its own cabin.
- **Upgrades:** Iris and Lea were each moved up one cabin because their own cabin was full on a flight that got them there sooner. Ben also asked for a faster flight, but no seat one cabin up was left on the flights that would get him there sooner, so he stays in economy.
- **Connections:** The original AA1402 connection would have been broken for Dev and Mo. I rebooked their onward leg on AA1410 the next morning.
- **Compensation:** Amounts follow how much later each passenger reaches their final destination. Hotel vouchers went to those arriving on a later date.
